remarks: This stunning beautifully renovated home is moments to downtown Greenwich. Chic & impeccably maintained show house is move-in ready & sits on a beautifully landscaped private corner lot with fenced yard. There is an open, flexible floor plan with hardwood floors & oversized windows. The gorgeous & bright kitchen has attractive marble counter tops & an adjacent dining area. French doors lead to a large deck & level yard. Also on this level is the sunny living room with fireplace, 3 bedrooms, including the lovely primary, 2 full baths, one half bath, playroom, dining room/office & laundry. Walkout garden level features bedroom with full bath. Attached extra deep two-car garage has storage space. Close to Brunswick, Greenwich Academy & North Street schools. Special & very nice.
